sentence: She visited her grandmother last weekend
hint: Subject + past verb + object + time expression
explanation: Pasado regular: se añade -ed. Las expresiones de tiempo van al final.

sentence: They went to the beach yesterday
explanation: 'Go' es irregular: went (no 'goed'). 'Yesterday' va al final.

sentence: I ate a sandwich for lunch
explanation: 'Eat' es irregular: ate (no 'eated').

sentence: He did not go to work yesterday
hint: Negative past: did not + base form
explanation: Después de 'did not', se usa la forma base 'go', no 'went'.

sentence: We watched a movie last night
explanation: Pasado regular: watch → watched. El tiempo va al final.

sentence: Did you see the new teacher
hint: Past questions: Did + subject + base form
explanation: Después de 'Did', se usa la forma base 'see', no 'saw'.

sentence: She bought a new dress at the mall
explanation: 'Buy' es irregular: bought (no 'buyed').

sentence: The children played in the garden all afternoon
explanation: Sujeto + verbo en pasado + lugar + duración de tiempo.

sentence: I did not understand the question
explanation: Después de 'did not', se usa la forma base 'understand', no 'understood'.

sentence: He wrote a letter to his friend
explanation: 'Write' es irregular: wrote (no 'writed').

sentence: We arrived at the airport two hours early
explanation: Sujeto + verbo en pasado + lugar + tiempo.

sentence: Did they finish the homework on time
explanation: Después de 'Did', se usa la forma base 'finish', no 'finished'.

sentence: She made a cake for her birthday
explanation: 'Make' es irregular: made (no 'maked').

sentence: I took the bus to school this morning
explanation: 'Take' es irregular: took (no 'taked').

sentence: They did not want to leave the party
explanation: Después de 'did not', se usa la forma base 'want', no 'wanted'.

sentence: He ran five kilometers in the park
explanation: 'Run' es irregular: ran (no 'runned').

sentence: We had a great time at the concert
explanation: 'Have' es irregular: had. El adjetivo va antes del sustantivo: 'great time'.

sentence: Did she call you after the meeting
explanation: Después de 'Did', se usa la forma base 'call', no 'called'.

sentence: The train left the station ten minutes ago
explanation: 'Leave' es irregular: left. 'Ago' va al final de todo.

sentence: I found my keys under the sofa
explanation: 'Find' es irregular: found (no 'finded').
